clips.title: The story
paras: Marshal Marris is pressing the Blackrock Blockade east of Lake Everstill. Lakeshire's guard aims to starve out the Blackrock orcs and take their weapons.

Blackrock raiders in Redridge are pushing Alliance forces to their limits. Cut off from regular supply trains, their forward parties live off the hills. Marshal Marris knows even fierce orcs cannot keep fighting without food and steel.
South of Stonewatch Keep, Blackrock camps lead the clan's advance. Lakeshire's defenders strike those camps to seize supplies and stolen weapons, weakening the orcs' fighting strength and morale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You can't fight a war without weapons.
Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.
Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.
We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.
